methods.label: Self-Refine
methods.behavior: Initial answer, then up to two intrinsic critique/revision rounds; stop after a verified answer.

methods.label: Reflexion
methods.behavior: Initial answer, then up to two item-local reflection/revision rounds using verifier feedback.

methods.label: Verifier-Retry
methods.behavior: Initial answer plus up to four verifier-feedback repairs; no assistance payload.

methods.label: ReAct-MCP
methods.behavior: Model chooses an ACTION from the four assistance tools; at most four follow-up turns.

methods.label: Adapted VerifiAgent
methods.behavior: Up to two meta-verification / strongest-partial-aid / revision rounds after the initial answer.

methods.label: Best-of-N
methods.behavior: At most five candidates; first uses the base prompt and later candidates a fixed independent-candidate prompt.

methods.label: GateMCP
methods.behavior: Verify the autonomous attempt; escalate L1 to L4 only after failures; stop at first success.

methods.label: Fixed
methods.behavior: Call L4 for every item, including autonomous successes; at most two guided repairs reuse that payload.

methods.label: Random-Order
methods.behavior: Per-item seed-derived permutation of L1-L4; verify and stop at first success.

methods.label: Repeated-Strong
methods.behavior: After autonomous failure, call L4 again on each of at most four repairs; early stop.

methods.label: Strongest-on-Failure
methods.behavior: After autonomous failure, call L4 once for one guided repair.

methods.label: Full-Cascade
methods.behavior: Run L1-L4 even after intermediate success; score the final attempt only.

methods.label: GateMCP-NoGate
methods.behavior: Use SELF_CHECK to stop/escalate; strict verifier is hidden from routing/prompts and scores the final attempt.
